**Aguma Shrine** (あぐまじんじゃ) is a Shinto shrine located at Sōjin, Senju-chō Tenma, Ichinomiya City, Aichi Prefecture, Japan. It is identified with the “Aguma Shrine” of Niwa District in Owari Province listed in the *Engishiki Jinmyōchō*, but this identification is not definitive.

== History ==
{{Empty section|date=September 2019}}
Until the Edo period, it was called **Tenjin** and served as the tutelary shrine of Tenma Village in Niwa District. The early Edo-period document *Kanbun Muramura Oboegaki* records “Tenma Village… Tenjin.”

The “Aguma Shrine” of Niwa District listed in the *Engishiki Jinmyōchō* had an unknown location, but scholars such as Amano Nobukage identified it with this shrine. However, the basis for identifying this shrine as Aguma Shrine is not clear.
